back: The release of harmful substances or energy (e.g. noise) into air, water or land.
A substance or form of energy that causes pollution, e.g. smoke, sewage, plastic, mercury, noise.
One identifiable place pollution comes from, e.g. a factory pipe.
Pollution from many scattered places, e.g. fertiliser washed off many farms.

front: Name the four main types of pollution.
Which agency licenses and monitors polluters in Zimbabwe?
back: The Environmental Management Agency (EMA), under the Environmental Management Act.
Whoever causes pollution should pay for the damage and the clean-up.

front: Why is pollution usually highest in towns and mining areas?
back: Many people, vehicles, factories and waste are crowded together, and mines release dust and chemicals.

front: Why may a ban on burning rubbish fail?
back: If refuse is not collected, people have no realistic alternative and keep burning it.
